newsitem.title: DENMARK: Lauritzen offers share in Danyard unit.
newsitem.headline: Lauritzen offers share in Danyard unit.

text.p: Danish shipping group J.Lauritzen A/S said on Wednesday that in addition to the sale of 48 percent of its Danyard shipbuilding unit to a Malaysian firm it would offer a further 27 percent to institutional investors in Denmark.
Lauritzen announced earlier that it had sold 48 percent of Danyard for $100 million to Malaysia's Penang Shipbuilding Construction SDN BHD (PSC) in a programme to revive the loss-making yard.
It later said that Danish investors would be offered 27 percent of the restructured local shipbuilder, but if they did not accept the offer PSC would take the additional stake.

"A strategic alliance with a highly successful far-eastern partner...as well as a very significant capital injection, offer the yard the prospect of a new future," Lauritzen said in a statement to the Copenhagen Stock Exchange. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
